chunks: Tell: O People of the Book, come to a common word between us and you, that we worship none but God, and make none His compeer, and that none of us take others for lords apart from God. If they turn away, say: Bear witness that we are Muslims (submitting).

key_terms.أَلَّا نَعْبُدَ إِلَّا اللَّهَ: That we worship none but God

ai.seo_question: What is the common word between Muslims and People of the Book according to Surah Aal--Imran?
ai.summary: Known as the Verse of Invitation (Ayat al-Da'wah), this verse was revealed to establish a monotheistic consensus with Jews and Christians, emphasizing pure Tawhid and the rejection of divine status for prophets or scholars. In Shia exegesis, it underscores the principle of not taking religious authorities as lords apart from Allah, linking the call to submission with the ultimate witness of Islam.
